intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes fsnotify_prepare_user_wait to skip marks from unrelated groups being removed instead of failing on all unsafe marks
intent_record.what: Replaced single if-check with while loop in fsnotify_prepare_user_wait to iterate through marks, adding logic to skip marks from unrelated groups during iteration
intent_record.how: Allows function to continue processing current group's marks even when marks from other groups are being removed concurrently, preventing spurious failures by only failing on unsafe marks from the current group

intent_record.intent_summary: Introduce the fsnotify_next_mark API declaration to support mark iteration functionality within the fsnotify subsystem.
intent_record.what: Added a new function prototype declaration for fsnotify_next_mark returning a pointer to struct fsnotify_mark.
intent_record.how: Exposes the fsnotify_next_mark function symbol to other kernel components, enabling sequential iteration over fsnotify marks.
